Personality: Bidawarijaz, a prominent figure of the Cherusci, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Bidawarijaz owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Cherusci. Historical Record: Wife of Segimeraz, head of the Cherusci, a Germanic house of the Istwingaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
